page.description: OpenIndiana Hipster ISO: size, architecture and the project's published SHA-256.
page.intro: An Illumos-based system, the open continuation of OpenSolaris. The Hipster branch is the rolling release; the GUI image is the one to write.
pros: ZFS as the root filesystem, managed by the Illumos tooling.
Zones and crossbow networking from the Solaris lineage.
Rolling Hipster branch with periodic images.
The project publishes a per-image SHA-256 file.
cons: Not Linux and not BSD: the Illumos userland and driver set differ from both.
Hardware support is narrower than on Linux.
The version is the image date (2026-04-30).
The Commons screenshot is older than this image.
page.previewNote: A stock screenshot of an OpenIndiana desktop from Wikimedia Commons. It is not the 20260430 image and not a ROMinit recording: no image was written and nothing was booted for this page.

page.status: One image: the GUI ISO, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk. The version is the image date (2026-04-30).
